text:
sam: Weekend check-in! I'm deciding between joining the harbor beach cleanup on Saturday morning 🗑️🌊 or staying home to finally nail my sourdough starter. Who's up for either?
tessa: I can do the cleanup — meet at the pier at 9? I'll bring gloves and extra trash bags.
aj: 9 works for me. I'll bring my reusable buckets :thumbsup:.
maria: Tempting, but I promised my niece a museum visit. I can swing by the cleanup for an hour though. Is there a sign-up?
sam: Yup — here's the signup: https://orgs.example/cleanup (they asked volunteers to register for t-shirts) :t_rex: 
tessa: Also if anyone wants sourdough tips, @maria helped me get a starter going last month.
maria: False advertising — I mostly fed it and nearly burnt the apartment the first week :joy:
aj: I'm leaning picnic after the cleanup. If we finish early, picnic at the pier? I'll bring hummus + crackers.
sam: Picnic sounds great. If weather looks iffy, fallback is boardgames in the office lounge. @tessa can you reserve the lounge just in case?
tessa: On it. Booking now and I'll order coffee for the morning volunteers ☕
dev-bot: Reminder: office lounge reserved Sat 1–4pm by tessa
lee: I might skip the cleanup and try sourdough — been wanting to learn. Any tips?
sam: quick poll — reply with one emoji for what you're doing: 🗑️ cleanup / 🥖 sourdough / 🧺 picnic / 🖼️ museum
aj: 🗑️🧺
maria: 🖼️
tessa: 🗑️🧺
lee: 🥖
sam: Looks like cleanup -> picnic has the lead. I'll add the combined event to the calendar and DM folks with details. See y'all Saturday! :wave:
